title: Light in a jet
title_note: The letter makes no "first" claim. Its last paragraph dates the work: the experiments are "antérieures de plusieurs mois" to the note Plateau read at the Brussels Academy on 4 July 1842; the Conservatoire des Arts et Métiers in Paris has held one of the apparatus since October 1841, built by M. Bourbouze at M. Pouillet's request; others were made for public courses in London; all results were repeated in the Geneva physics and mechanics courses in June 1841 (Colladon, Comptes rendus 1842, p.801-802). "Fontaine Colladon" is the name physics cabinets used for the apparatus by 1884 (La Nature 1884, p.325); the 1842 letter does not use it.
tagline: Sunlight trapped by total internal reflection follows a falling water jet.

parts.name: Rectangular vessel
parts.role: One metre tall (stated); jet leaves one face, light enters the opposite. Width and depth assumed.
parts.detail: A rectangular vessel 1 m high. One face carries the orifice a little above the bottom; the opposite wall carries the lens on the same axis. Width, depth, wall thickness and wall material are not given. The 1884 engraving (La Nature, p.325) draws an open box on a pedestal, lit water showing through its front; whether the 1842 walls were glass is not stated. Drawn semi-transparent so the light path shows (a rendering choice).
parts.quote: L'appareil que j'emploie pour ces essais se compose d'un vase parallélipédique de 1 mètre de hauteur

parts.name: Water
parts.role: Clear water at room temperature; the jet's light-carrying medium. Fill level assumed.
parts.detail: The letter asks for perfectly clear ("parfaitement limpide") water and a clean diaphragm edge: then the jet is barely visible although intense light circulates inside it. The one essential precaution: water at the room's temperature, so that no dew forms on the outer face of the lens. Fill level and how the level was kept during a demonstration are not given; the model keeps a constant level (assumed).
parts.quote: Si l'eau est parfaitement limpide et l'ouverture du diaphragme bien nette, la veine est à peine visible, quoiqu'une lumière très-intense circule dans son intérieur.

parts.name: Screw-in diaphragm
parts.role: Interchangeable orifice plate near the bottom; sets the jet size. Apertures assumed.
parts.detail: On one face, a little above the bottom, an opening takes different screw-in diaphragms that vary the size of the jet (La Nature 1884 adds "et la forme", and the shape). No aperture is given. A jet of only a few millimetres breaks into drops in its lower part (see Drops); the continuous jet here uses a larger assumed aperture, the drops chapter a few-millimetre one.
parts.quote: sur une des faces, un peu au-dessus du fond, est une ouverture, où s'adaptent à vis différents diaphragmes pour varier la grosseur du jet

parts.name: Water jet
parts.role: Leaves horizontally and falls in a parabola; the light guide. Path derived from an assumed head.
parts.detail: The vein leaves the vessel horizontally; the title calls it parabolic ("veine liquide parabolique"). The letter prints no head, speed or range. Path drawn as an ideal free jet: efflux speed v = (2gh)^{1/2} (Torricelli), launched horizontally, drops y = x^{2}/(4h) at distance x; contraction and friction ignored. Assumed head h = 800 mm: the jet lands 1.29 m out after a 520 mm drop. Diameter drawn constant (a real jet thins as it speeds up).
parts.quote: Cette veine s'échappe du vase dans une direction horizontale

parts.name: Convex lens
parts.role: In the opposite wall; converges the beam into the orifice. Size assumed.
parts.detail: A hole is pierced in the opposite wall on the jet's axis and a convex lens fitted to it. The rays cross the lens and the water and converge in the orifice, so the lens focuses at the orifice. Diameter, focal length and glass are not given. Its outer face must stay free of dew (use water at room temperature, p.801).
parts.quote: pour l'éclairer intérieurement on perce un trou dans la paroi opposée sur la même direction, et on adapte à ce trou une lentille convexe

parts.name: Blackened tube
parts.role: Horizontal tube outside the vessel; blocks rays oblique to the jet axis. Length and bore assumed.
parts.detail: "Un tube horizontal, noirci à l'intérieur" added outside the vessel to keep rays oblique to the jet's axis out of the vessel. Its other end fits the hole in the window shutter. Length and bore are not given; the 1884 text calls it "un tube court" (a short tube). Outside finish not stated.
parts.quote: on ajoute en dehors du vase un tube horizontal, noirci à l'intérieur, destiné à empêcher les rayons obliques à l'axe du jet de pénétrer dans le vase

parts.name: Window shutter
parts.role: Shutter of the darkened room; the tube fits a hole in it. Plain stand-in, size assumed.
parts.detail: The apparatus is placed in a darkened room ("chambre obscure"); one of the room's shutters is pierced with a hole into which the blackened tube fits. Shown as a plain panel with a hole: shutter size, construction and the room are not described.

parts.name: Mirror
parts.role: Outside the shutter; sends a sunlight beam along the tube axis. Size, place and sun direction assumed.
parts.detail: "L'on renvoie par un miroir un faisceau de lumière solaire parallèlement à l'axe du tube." Mirror size, mount and whether it was a hand-set mirror or a heliostat are not given; shown as a plain flat plate. Its tilt follows the law of reflection for an assumed sun direction (elevation 30 deg, from the +z side), so that the reflected beam runs along the tube axis.
parts.quote: l'on renvoie par un miroir un faisceau de lumière solaire parallèlement à l'axe du tube

parts.name: Light beam
parts.role: Sunlight, parallel to the tube axis, then converging through the water. Width = assumed lens size.
parts.detail: Sunlight sent by the mirror parallel to the tube axis passes the shutter hole and the blackened tube, crosses the lens and the water, and converges in the orifice. The letter uses sunlight; La Nature 1884 adds that an oxyhydrogen or electric lamp projecting a horizontal beam also works, as its engraving shows. Beam width = assumed lens aperture.
parts.quote: Les rayons lumineux traversent la lentille et le liquide, et vont converger dans l'ouverture par laquelle s'échappe la veine

parts.name: Light in the jet
parts.role: Totally reflected at each incidence; follows every bend of the jet. Rays schematic.
parts.detail: Once inside the vein the rays meet its surface at an angle small enough for total internal reflection; the same happens at each new point of incidence, so the light circulates in the transparent jet as in a canal and follows all its bends. Drawn as a few schematic rays: the letter gives no angle, refractive index or intensity. In clear water the jet itself stays barely visible.
parts.quote: une fois entrés dans la veine, ils rencontrent sa surface sous un angle assez petit pour éprouver une réflexion intérieure totale; le même effet se reproduit à chaque nouveau point d'incidence, en sorte que la lumière circule dans ce jet transparent comme dans un canal, et en suit toutes les inflexions

parts.name: Basin
parts.role: Set level, receives the jet; its bottom lights up. Size and place assumed.
parts.detail: Wherever the vein meets a solid body that interrupts it, the light it carried escapes and the points of contact become luminous: receiving the jet in a basin set horizontally, the basin's bottom is lit by the light that left the vessel through the vein. Basin size, material and position are not given; placed where the derived jet path lands.
parts.quote: Ainsi, en recevant le jet dans un bassin posé horizontalement, le fond de ce bassin se trouve illuminé par la lumière sortie du vase à travers la veine.

parts.name: Escaping light
parts.role: Light leaves the jet where a solid interrupts it. Glow illustrative.
parts.detail: "Partout où cette veine rencontre un corps solide qui l'interrompt, la lumière qu'elle contenait s'échappe, et les points de contact deviennent lumineux" (wherever the vein meets a solid that interrupts it, the light it contained escapes and the contact points become luminous). Drawn as a glow on the basin bottom around the landing point; extent and brightness are illustrative.
parts.quote: Mais partout où cette veine rencontre un corps solide qui l'interrompt, la lumière qu'elle contenait s'échappe, et les points de contact deviennent lumineux.

parts.name: Drops
parts.role: A thin jet breaks into drops low down; each break flashes. Drop size, spacing and glow illustrative.
parts.detail: If the vein falls from a great height, or if its diameter is only a few millimetres, it breaks into drops in its lower part; only there does the liquid light up, and each rupture point of the vein throws out a bright light. Where the break-up starts is not given; the model starts it in the lower half of the path (assumed).
parts.quote: Si la veine tombe d'une grande hauteur, ou si son diamètre n'est que de quelques millimètres, elle se réduit en gouttes dans sa partie inférieure. C'est là seulement que le liquide s'éclaire, et chaque point de rupture de la veine lance une vive lumière.

dims.label: break-up start
dims.locator: letter: 'dans sa partie inférieure' (Colladon, Comptes rendus 1842, p.801)

parts.name: Clouded water
parts.role: Dust or solutions scatter the light; the jet's upper part glows. Glow illustrative.
parts.detail: To make the jet visible near the orifice (to study the contraction of the vein), the water must be clouded, either with solutions or with dust mixed in: the light then disperses as it leaves the vessel and the vein becomes luminous in its upper part. Additives and amounts are not given; the glow fades downstream (illustrative).
parts.quote: il est indispensable de louchir l'eau, soit avec des solutions, soit en y mélangeant des poussières; la lumière se disperse à sa sortie du vase, et la veine devient lumineuse à sa partie supérieure

chapters.line: To show students a water jet, light it from inside.
chapters.action: whole apparatus floats in, unlit and ghosted, slow orbit; ordinary room light

chapters.line: A rectangular vessel, one metre tall, fills with water.
chapters.action: vessel lowers onto the stand; water level rises to the assumed fill line

chapters.line: Near the bottom, interchangeable diaphragms set the jet's size.
chapters.action: diaphragm plate screws into the opening on the +x face (one turn), aperture visible

chapters.line: Water leaves horizontally and falls in a parabola into a basin.
chapters.action: basin set on the floor first; jet grows from the orifice along the derived parabola and lands in it; level stays constant

chapters.line: A convex lens opposite the orifice; a blackened tube outside.
chapters.action: lens seats in the -x wall on the jet axis; tube slides on from outside, its inside visibly black

chapters.line: The tube fits a hole in a window shutter.
chapters.action: shutter panel rises behind the tube; ambient light falls to near dark; jet keeps running

chapters.line: Outside, a mirror sends sunlight along the tube's axis.
chapters.action: sun rays (assumed direction) strike the mirror; reflected parallel beam enters the shutter hole and runs down the tube to the lens

chapters.line: The rays cross the water and converge in the orifice.
chapters.action: beam leaves the lens as a cone in the water, apex at the orifice

chapters.line: Light follows every bend of the jet, as in a canal.
chapters.action: a few schematic rays zigzag along the jet at glancing angles, reflecting at each incidence and following the curve; the jet itself stays faint

chapters.line: Clear water: the jet barely shows; the basin floor lights up.
chapters.action: jet barely visible; glow spreads on the basin bottom around the landing point; rays stop at the contact

chapters.line: Thin jets break into flashing drops; clouded water lights the upper jet.
chapters.action: first half: small diaphragm swaps in, jet thins, lower half breaks into seeded drops that flash at each rupture, upper part dark; second half: larger diaphragm back, continuous jet, water faintly milky, jet glows brightest at the orifice fading downstream; held final frame

drawings.caption_note: Engraving signed Poyet; per the editor's introduction Colladon supplied the drawing ("M. D. Colladon a bien voulu nous communiquer le dessin de son expérience"), and the apparatus "n'a jamais été représenté" before. It shows the lamp-lit form ("une lampe oxyhydrique ou électrique projetant un faisceau de lumière horizontale comme le représente la figure ci-dessus", p.325), not the 1842 sunlight set-up; no printed scale; the orifice is drawn about two fifths (0.39) of the way up the vessel, the text says a little above the bottom.
